display_name: 时频网络源域响应单步学习率对照
description: 基于先前源域单步损失上升，探索两个更小学习率下波形和响应项的输出头单步行为。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 CPU, two threads, CUDA hidden; source-only fixed evaluation

data.version: 64 previously explored source pilot records, 16 per each of four fixed RX/view groups
data.representation: paired source IQ and one synthetic 1% RMS amplitude-cubic perturbation through DURA estimated action
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: Each of four groups first 8 fit and next 8 heldout; 64 unique records, disjoint from direct fit

roles.L_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth not read
roles.U_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth hidden

data.validation_ref: Frozen DURA real-source smoke and finite source waveform metrics
data.leo_config_ref: fixed source epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Single in-memory CPU AdamW step on output heads only; no trained model, identity or target performance claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh CrossExpertRefiner initialized with 2026110830; frozen DURA and direct source final20
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Direct source final20 fit disjoint from fixed source pilot; no in-flight training state loaded
checkpoint.selection_rule: Rates 3e-5 and 3e-6, both wave-only and wave+0.01 response, one independent step each; no checkpoint saved

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two threads, CUDA hidden; preserve all existing jobs

execution.stop_rule: Stop on provenance mismatch, nonfinite values, real-source smoke mismatch, output collision or technical failure

dimensions: two learning rates x two objectives
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: source clean IQ only, no TX truth

rows.method: Two reduced AdamW rates x wave-only versus wave plus response
rows.purpose: Explore source finite-step sensitivity after previously observed overshoot
rows.seed_notes: Fresh model initialization uses in-flight model seed 2026110830; no in-flight checkpoint is read.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, head parameters only, weight decay .001
rows.budget_ref: 32 fit + 32 heldout source records, four independent single steps at 3e-5 or 3e-6, CPU two threads, no saved weights

notes: Exploratory source-only follow-up to previously observed 3e-4 head-step loss increase; no target feedback.
Same fixed 32 fit and 32 heldout source records; original DURA overlap unknown; no F/TX/V/target reads.
Two independent learning rates 3e-5 and 3e-6, each wave-only and wave+0.01 response; one output-head AdamW step per condition, no weights saved.
Nine focused tests and one independent targeted P0/P1 review passed; real-source checkpoint smoke first.
CPU in-memory single-step diagnostic, not actual GPU training, an independently blind test, identity accuracy or target performance.
